title: Sliding window maximum
description: Implement sliding_window_max(values, k). values is a list of ints and k is the window length. Return a list with the maximum of each contiguous window of length k as the window slides one step to the right.
invariants: Raises ValueError when k is smaller than 1.
Only complete windows are reported, so a k larger than len(values) gives an empty list.
An empty values list gives an empty list.
